Subject: Post-demo: HelioBank decision roles & pilot next steps

Jessica — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick call recap and concrete next steps so we keep momentum toward a pilot: 

Call recap (2 min):
- Primary use case: condense customer support transcripts + triage automation for onboarding flows.
- Success metric: 30% reduction in live-handled tickets in first 60 days; one-week TTR improvement.
- Preferred models: accuracy over hallucination for short summaries; latency target <400ms p95 for 512-token flows.

Asks / Open items:
1) Decision roles — can you confirm names/emails for: economic buyer, security lead, and procurement owner? (we need explicit approver names to draft the mutual action plan)
2) Procurement cadence — do you have a standard SOW/PO timeline? Any contracting templates we should use?
3) Security checklist — will Anita run a brief SOC2/infra review or should we send a tailored security summary first?
4) Pilot success criteria — is the 30% reduction a realistic goal for your team or should we aim for a different KPI for the initial 30-day scope?

Attachments: redwood-pilot-outline.pdf (2 pages) — high level SOW and pilot logistics.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm roles above (this week)
- We share a 1-page mutual action plan and a pilot success metric sheet (by Tue 10/13) — Kimberly
- Proposed pilot start: early Nov, pending procurement

I cc'd Ben and Sean who will help with contract and security coordination on our side. If easier, happy to hop on a 20-min sync with Mark and Anita — suggest Wed 10/14 10:00am PT.

Thanks — forwarding a short one-pager to make internal championing easier.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
